## The shape of a module {#shape}

A 40-minute briefing (at most 30 minutes of exposition, at least 8 of live activity), a
70-minute lab (at most 52 minutes of core exercises, 51 plus a 3-minute reconnect after
lunch), and a 10-minute debrief: the room's numbers (4 minutes), one misconception (3) and
the bridge to the next module (3).

## Before the workshop {#before}

Run every notebook on a fresh Colab runtime in the week before, and file each run record
(`scripts/add_run_record.py`). A laptop or CI run is not a Colab run.
